items.title: Steve Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 25, 2002
items.q: I went out and sat in with different people and met a lot of different people, sitting in with people like Jon Faddis or David Murray

ctx.x: Did you arrive with any contacts in place?

Yeah. Fortunately. I had just joined a band called Out of the Blue, which was a young lions group put together by Blue Note Records at the time. And I replaced Kenny Garrett who had gone on to join Art Blakey and then subsequently Miles. So I was in that band when I got to New York but the band didn’t have any work. So I had to start all over again. While I was living in Virginia I was in a fusion group that was working all the time and I was working other jazz gigs, so I gave all of that up to move to New York.…
What kind of places did those jam sessions happen in back then? Were they small clubs and that kind of thing?
